import type { NextConfig } from "next";

const config: NextConfig = {
  experimental: { cpus: 1 },
  webpack(config, context) {
    config.plugins.push({
      apply(compiler) {
        const name = `${context.isServer ? "server" : "client"}:${context.nextRuntime ?? "browser"}`;
        let started = 0;
        let modules = [];
        let times = new WeakMap();
        compiler.hooks.invalid.tap("PlaygroundProfile", (file) => console.log("NEXT_PROFILE", JSON.stringify({ name, phase: "invalid", file, at: Date.now() })));
        compiler.hooks.compile.tap("PlaygroundProfile", () => {
          started = Date.now();
          modules = [];
          times = new WeakMap();
          console.log("NEXT_PROFILE", JSON.stringify({ name, phase: "compile", at: started }));
        });
        compiler.hooks.compilation.tap("PlaygroundProfile", compilation => {
          compilation.hooks.buildModule.tap("PlaygroundProfile", module => times.set(module, Date.now()));
          compilation.hooks.succeedModule.tap("PlaygroundProfile", module => modules.push({ id: module.identifier(), ms: Date.now() - times.get(module) }));
        });
        compiler.hooks.done.tap("PlaygroundProfile", () => {
          modules.sort((a, b) => b.ms - a.ms);
          console.log("NEXT_PROFILE", JSON.stringify({ name, phase: "done", at: Date.now(), ms: Date.now() - started, built: modules.length, modules: modules.slice(0, 12) }));
        });
      },
    });
    return config;
  },
};

export default config;
